title: Florida man jailed 47 months for AI-cloning N3on's voice in $260K crypto theft
summary_full: David Anthony Sanchez has been sentenced to 47 months in prison for defrauding a meme coin project out of $260,000 in cryptocurrency by mimicking streamer N3on's voice using artificial intelligence. He set up deceptive accounts posing as N3on and convinced project organizers to transfer cryptocurrency, all while utilizing AI-generated voice recordings that seemed authentic.
